name: staleness-guard
description: An Agent Skill that overrides the instinct to answer from confidence. Before the agent states any claim about the present-day world, the user's local environment, its own platform and tool capabilities, or uploaded and mounted source material, it runs the tool that can verify the claim and bases the statement on what the tool returns; if a relevant tool exists and is not used, the claim is not made. One rule, no confidence threshold, no category exempt. Ships a companion staleness register.
